tasks.short: Communicate soil and plant research or teach related sessions.

steps.what: Verify actual research or project results and choose audience-appropriate teaching content
Write explanations and examples for research communication, courses, seminars or workshops

loop.purpose: Draft audience-appropriate explanations of verified soil and plant results
loop.input: Scientist-selected content, actual results, limitations and audience brief
loop.check: Scientist checks scientific meaning, omitted conditions, misleading simplification and invented examples against actual sources
loop.stop: Missing source or two failed revisions returns writing to the scientist
loop.why_not_simpler: Native headings and reusable course content come first; explanatory prose varies by audience and actual results

steps.what: Check the final communication or teaching version and its audience
outputs: checked final scientific communication or teaching material

steps.what: Save the checked final scientific communication or teaching material
inputs: checked final scientific communication or teaching material

steps.what: Send the exact checked material to the actual professional or public audience
Communicate research results or teach actual courses, seminars or workshops
outputs: actual scientific communication and teaching discussion

tasks.design: Reuse existing course headings and verified research content in {DOCS} before adding a bounded draft of explanations. The scientist checks the exact final content and audience before saving and sending it, then communicates and teaches personally.
tasks.previous_blocker: Audience-specific explanations can take repeated first-draft writing.
tasks.enabler_now: Bounded drafting can start from actual selected findings and existing teaching content.
tasks.still_hard: Explaining limitations and responding to farmers, professionals or learners requires subject judgement.
tasks.human_edge: The scientist notices misunderstanding and adjusts the explanation without overstating the evidence.
tasks.altitude: Less first-draft preparation; scientific and teaching authority stay unchanged.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: source-linked language drafting can support scientific teaching material but needs scientific and audience-meaning checks.

assumptions: Boundary is actual communication or teaching and its existing material. These are alternative activity branches; reweight to actual work rather than adding a course to each result communication.

The scientist supplies verified result, condition, source version, limitation and actual audience in s1. Missing sources are retrieved manually there; the model invents neither measurements nor examples. Actual participant questions arise only in s6.
Test native templates and reusable content first. Existing content reuse earns no new saving; scientific selection, final checking and teaching remain fully retained.
Shares are provisional scenarios, not measured baselines. The routine save and send are each one percent fully retained; no labour saving is assigned to them.
unknowns: How much teaching material is already reusable?
What is the actual written-communication versus live-teaching mix?
research_questions: Does bounded drafting reduce preparation after every explanation and example is checked?

incremental.description: Maintain source links and audience-specific drafting checks.

approvals.approved_version: s3 checked final scientific material and exact document destination; edits require recheck
s3 checked final scientific material and exact actual audience/recipient list; changes void approval

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Gross 24*0.40 prose = 9.6; subtract 1 upkeep = 8.6. With half the explanations eligible, 4.8 minus 1 = 3.8. Teaching, content judgement and save/send time remain unchanged.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Develop practical soil conservation and management methods.

steps.what: Find and assess actual soil, climate and prior land-management evidence
Examine actual soil conditions and test conservation or management practices
Develop feasible soil conservation or management methods for farmers or forestry companies
Write and check the soil management method and its actual evidence references
outputs: checked final soil management method record

steps.what: Save the checked soil management method record
inputs: checked final soil management method record

tasks.design: Configure site and topic filters in the research database {OTHER}, and source-reference fields in {DOCS}. The scientist reads evidence, examines and tests actual land, develops a practical method and records the method; only finding and repeating references change.
tasks.previous_blocker: Developing methods can require repeated retrieval of site and trial references.
tasks.enabler_now: Native metadata filters and reference fields can reduce finding and repeated source entry.
tasks.still_hard: Soil behaviour, weather and farm constraints make transferring a method between sites uncertain.
tasks.human_edge: The scientist judges whether a method is practical for the actual grower or forestry operation.
tasks.altitude: Less source handling; method-development authority stays unchanged.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: research filters and controlled source references can support soil method development; choosing a conservation method remains scientific work.

assumptions: Boundary includes actual method development and its existing method record. Farm implementation and farmer labour are not counted as scientist time.

Site-record owner supplies actual plot identifier, soil description, location, management history and source revision where available; research database supplies indexed metadata. The scientist verifies evidence in s1 and captures field observations in s2. Missing metadata and unsupported records remain manual.
Test native search and reference fields before code. Source reading remains within s1; only repeated source and context fields change in s4. Existing search configuration earns no new saving.
Shares are provisional scenarios, not measured baselines. Same-system save is one percent fully retained and uses the existing method-record check.
unknowns: How much source finding is repeated?
Are plot history and trial references indexed consistently?
research_questions: Does configured retrieval shorten source finding without reducing scientific assessment or fieldwork?

incremental.description: Maintain soil-topic filters and method reference fields.

approvals.approved_version: s4 checked final soil management method record and exact document destination; edits require recheck

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Gross 20*0.30 source finding + 9*0.20 repeated references = 7.8; subtract 0.8 upkeep = 7. With half the retrieval and repeated fields eligible, 3.9 minus 0.8 = 3.1. Fieldwork and method development stay unchanged.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Advise landowners on land use, growth and erosion.

steps.what: Find actual land, soil, crop and erosion evidence for the landowner question
Inspect actual land, plant growth and erosion conditions
Provide information or recommendations to farmers or landowners on actual site problems
Write and check the actual written land-use recommendation and recipient

loop.purpose: Draft written follow-up from scientist-chosen site advice
loop.input: Actual site observations, chosen recommendations, qualifications and recipient
loop.check: Scientist checks meaning, missing site conditions, unsupported agronomic promises and consistency with actual advice and recipient
loop.stop: Missing actual advice or two failed revisions returns writing to the scientist
loop.why_not_simpler: Use existing letter fields first; site-specific explanations cannot be filled only from fixed fields

steps.what: Send the exact checked recommendation to the actual landowner

tasks.design: Use native site-reference filters in {DOCS} and the geographic records system {OTHER}. The scientist inspects the site and gives advice personally; a bounded draft can reduce existing written follow-up work, with the scientist checking its final meaning and recipient before the separate send.
tasks.previous_blocker: Site sources can be hard to find and written recommendations repeat the scientist's actual advice.
tasks.enabler_now: Native retrieval and bounded drafting can reduce source finding and first-draft correspondence.
tasks.still_hard: Correct advice depends on actual soil, weather, plant health and landowner constraints.
tasks.human_edge: The scientist judges practical trade-offs and recognises when site evidence is insufficient.
tasks.altitude: Less retrieval and follow-up prose; advisory authority stays unchanged.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: site-reference search and bounded drafting can support written land-use advice; neither replaces scientific site assessment.

assumptions: Boundary includes actual landowner advice and existing written follow-up, where given. Reweight oral-only cases rather than adding a letter. Landowner implementation work is outside the scientist denominator.

Landowner supplies the actual question, parcel and constraints; site-record owner supplies actual parcel identifier, source date and soil or crop information. The scientist verifies sources in s1, observes the actual site in s2 and supplies chosen advice in s3-s4. Missing records are sought manually; no transcript or structured advice is assumed free.

Test native retrieval and existing letter fields before code. Existing automated retrieval earns no saving. s4 retained time includes capturing actual advice and correcting generated meaning; field and advisory time are unchanged.
Shares are provisional scenarios, not measured baselines. The routine send is one percent fully retained; final letter checking is existing writing work, not an added approval stage.
unknowns: How often is advice followed by a written letter?
Are parcel records searchable and current?
research_questions: Does drafting save time after the scientist captures actual advice and checks all site-specific qualifications?

already_counted.description: Capture actual advice and correct draft meaning in s4.

incremental.description: Maintain site-reference filters and letter drafting checks.

approvals.approved_version: s4 checked final land-use recommendation letter and exact landowner recipient; edits void approval

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Gross 10*0.40 retrieval + 14*0.30 letter prose = 8.2; subtract 1 upkeep = 7.2. With half the retrieval and prose eligible, 4.1 minus 1 = 3.1. Site visits, advice and send time remain unchanged.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Experiment to develop improved field-crop varieties.

steps.what: Choose crop varieties, trial design, controls and actual evaluation criteria
Conduct actual field-crop experiments and observe yield, quality, disease and adaptation
Transfer and check actual field-trial measurements in the trial records system {OTHER}
Calculate preselected field-trial summaries and statistical comparisons
Interpret variety performance and write and check actual experiment findings
Save the checked actual crop-variety experiment findings

tasks.design: Test native field-measurement imports and preselected analysis configurations in the trial records system {OTHER}. The scientist chooses the experiment and statistical method, conducts actual crop work, verifies trial data and interprets and records the findings; calculations only repeat the chosen method.
tasks.previous_blocker: Plot measurements can be copied into analysis tables and the same comparisons rebuilt for each trial.
tasks.enabler_now: Native imports and reusable analysis configurations can reduce transcription and repetitive calculation setup.
tasks.still_hard: Weather, soil variability, missing plots and genotype-by-environment effects require scientific interpretation.
tasks.human_edge: The scientist recognises when an apparent improved variety is a site or trial artefact.
tasks.altitude: Less trial-data transfer; breeding and interpretation decisions stay unchanged.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: trial records and statistical tools can import plot data and repeat scientist-selected analyses; they do not establish variety superiority.

assumptions: Boundary includes actual variety experiments through existing findings. Crop commercialisation and regulatory decisions remain their actual owners' work with no avoided labour claimed.

The scientist creates actual plot, variety, replicate and treatment identifiers in s1-s2; instruments or the scientist capture actual yield, quality, disease score, date and unit during s2. The scientist verifies mapping and missing plots in s3. Unsupported field observations and missing data stay manual before s4.

The scientist chooses the statistical method and missing-data policy in s1. Native imports and analysis configuration come before code; existing automated calculations earn no new saving. No statistical or variety judgement is automated.
Shares and reductions are provisional, not measured baselines. Final save retains its one percent share and uses the existing findings check.
unknowns: Are trial analyses already reusable and validated?
research_questions: Can configured analysis reproduce actual prior trials, including missing plots, without changing scientist interpretation?

incremental.description: Maintain plot-field mappings and checked trial-analysis configurations.

approvals.approved_version: s5 checked final crop-variety experiment findings and exact trial-record destination; edits require recheck

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Gross 10*0.60 trial-data entry + 10 repeated calculation work = 16; subtract 1.5 upkeep = 14.5. If half the entry and calculations are still manual and eligible, 8 minus 1.5 = 6.5. Field experiments and scientific choices remain unchanged.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: The scientist keeps field, advisory and research authority while reducing repeated information handling and communication drafts.
role.ambitious_version: Formal decision rights stay unchanged; validate reduced preparation and transcription on actual soil and crop work.
